note: The template. The station works on its own copy (--config, default ~/kode-factory/test_dot_station.json), made from this file on first use. ssid_24 and ssid_5 are the two networks of the place where the station stands; their channels are filled in by test_dot_final.py --discover. A threshold of null only records the RSSI: the criterion is that each network and the beacon are heard. station names the station in the exit record and in the CSV's name. parallel_with_operator lists what the PC does while the operator presses and touches. place.window is the camera window of the last good placement, kept by the program.
